verdict.rationale: Tavily documents a freshness control: `max_age_hours` caps the age of its cached copy of each result, and 0 forces a live page fetch. It also markets real-time web access. However, nothing in the pack shows date-range or publication-recency filters on search results, and nothing describes how often the index is updated. missing for 10: date-range (start/end date) filters, publication-recency/time-range filters, documentation of index update frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of freshness.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can get fresh results with date-range and recency filters backed by a frequently updated index

citations.quote: max_age_hours sets the maximum age in hours of Tavily's cached copy of each result. Accepts 1 to 720, 0 to always fetch the page live
One secure API for real-time web access.
